Pocket Quran: privacy & support

Developer: Spiritual Developer
Contact: gsolconnect@gmail.com
Updated: 19 September 2026

This notice describes the current Android test build. Its intended audience is adults aged 18 and above. Live advertising is not enabled.

Your research

Notes, saved verses and reading preferences are stored on your device. We do not operate an account system or upload your notebook to a server. You control which backup files you import or export. An exported JSON file contains your research in readable form; store it somewhere you trust. If you choose a cloud storage provider in Android's file picker, that provider handles the selected file under its own terms.

Optional Google test ads

The Android test build includes Google Mobile Ads SDK. Tapping “Show Google test ad” starts the test advertising flow and makes network requests to Google. You can use the reader and notebook without requesting an ad. This demo uses Google's test identifiers and requests non-personalized ads with the G content rating. Those settings do not mean that no data is processed.

Google's SDK may collect and share IP addresses (which can indicate approximate location), device or account identifiers, app/ad interactions and diagnostics for advertising, measurement and fraud prevention. Our code does not send your research, search text, saved verses or religious profile to the advertising plugin. See Google's privacy policy and its SDK data disclosure.

“Hide ad” removes the current banner; it does not erase information already received by Google. The app does not request ads automatically. Closing the app ends the test session. You can manage your advertising ID through Android settings. Live-ad consent choices and account-level blocking controls must be configured before a production advertising release.

External websites and email

Source links open other providers' websites, whose privacy practices apply there. If you email support, we receive the information you send; avoid including private research unless necessary. Contact the email above to ask about support-message retention or deletion.

Deleting local information

You can delete notes and remove saved verses within the app. Clearing Android app data or uninstalling removes local research and settings. Copies you previously exported remain in the locations you selected and must be deleted separately. Export any research you want to keep before uninstalling.

Advertising suitability

Test banners are kept off reading and notebook screens. Before live ads are enabled, we plan strict category blocks and ongoing review. Automated filters cannot guarantee that every advertisement will suit every user's religious values. You can report concerns to the support address above.
